sentences.text:
ON THE 7 th OF AUGUST, 2025  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 31306 of 2025  ANIL  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS  Appearance:
 Mr. Surya Kumar Patel - Advocate for the applicant.
 Mr. Yogendra Das Yadav -G.A. for the State.
 ORDER
This is first bai l application filed on behalf of applicants under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

2. The applicant is in jail since 22.6.2025 in connection with Crime No.306 of 2024 registered at P.S. Amanganj, District- Panna for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 343, 376(2) (n)
and 506/34 of IPC and sections 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.

3. Prosecution story in brief is that applicant assisted co-accused persons in taking away the prosecutrix and allegation against co-accused Pawan is that he committed penetrative aggravated sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.
4.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 22.6.2025.
Only allegation against applicant is that he assisted co-accused in taking away the prosecutrix but in Court statement of prosecutrix, she has stated nothing against present applicant.
No custodial interrogation is required.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.

5. Learned Counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:36955 2 MCRC-31306-2025 opposed the application.

sentences.text: Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
10. Soft copy of this bail order be sent forthwith to the applicant through concerned Superintendent of Jail.
11. Certified copy as per rules.
(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Hashmi Anil vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95615160/
